# CustomDancePlayer v0.2.1

下载带 With-BepInEx 的整合包，退出游戏后解压到 MateEngineX.exe 同级。从 0.1.x 升级时，再运行 Run-OldVersionMigration.cmd。已有兼容 BepInEx 安装可使用插件包更新。

[使用说明](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/blob/v0.2.1/README_zh.md) · [安装与迁移](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/blob/v0.2.1/docs/user/INSTALL_0.2.md)


- 保留 VMD 原有的起始朝向，包括首帧侧身的动作；仍可手动开启固定朝向。
- IK 容差和可达余量随腿长缩放，改善人物显示尺寸很小时的动作表现。
- 修复关闭 MMD 运镜后拖动进度条仍套用舞蹈镜头的问题，包含旧 `.unity3d` 舞蹈。
- 密集烘焙的 VMD 镜头在渲染帧之间插值连续运动，减少运镜顿挫；保留独立切镜头和突变。

VMD 密集镜头采用保守的连续运动判断，特殊的小幅跳切仍可能有差异。如遇到问题，请在 [GitHub 提交 Issue](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/issues)，附上对应的 VMD、模型和复现步骤。

---

## English

For a first installation, download the With-BepInEx archive, exit the game, and extract everything beside MateEngineX.exe. When upgrading from 0.1.x, run Run-OldVersionMigration.cmd before starting the game. Use the smaller plugin archive to update an existing compatible BepInEx installation.

[User guide](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/blob/v0.2.1/README.md) · [Installation and migration](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/blob/v0.2.1/docs/user/INSTALL_0.2.md)


- Preserve the authored starting direction of VMD motions, including motions that begin facing sideways. Explicit facing lock remains available.
- Scale IK tolerances and reach margins with leg length to improve playback at very small display sizes.
- Prevent seeking from applying a disabled MMD camera, including legacy `.unity3d` dances.
- Interpolate continuous movement in densely baked VMD camera tracks between render frames, while retaining isolated cuts and abrupt transitions.

Dense VMD cameras use conservative continuity detection; unusual small cuts may still differ. Please [report issues](https://github.com/maoxig/MateEngine-CustomDancePlayer/issues) with the VMD, model, and reproduction steps.
